elements.name: Rewarded
elements.desc:
You were living a difficult life before your destiny suddenly changed through a miraculous turn of good fortune. Perhaps a benevolent deity gave you precisely what you most desired. You might have been down on your luck before a stranger handed you a fortune. Whatever the cause, your life was forever altered by a stroke of incredible luck.

Skill Proficiencies: Insight, Persuasion
Tool Proficiencies: A gaming set (matching your chosen proficiency)
Languages: One of your choice
Feat: You gain the Skilled, Lucky, or Magic Initiate feat (your choice).
Equipment: A bottle of black ink, an ink pen, five sheets of paper, a gaming set (matching your proficiency), a set of fine clothes, and a pouch containing 25 gp.

elements.name: Ruined
elements.desc:
You were on top of the world before misfortune struck. You might have been wealthy, surrounded by friends and family, or famous. Then, in a single calamitous moment—perhaps a draw from the Deck of Many Things—you lost everything. Your desperation has driven you to the life of an adventurer.

Skill Proficiencies: Stealth, Survival
Tool Proficiencies: A gaming set (matching your chosen proficiency)
Languages: One of your choice
Feat: You gain the Alert, Skilled, or Tough feat (your choice).
Equipment: A cracked hourglass, a set of rusty manacles, a gaming set (matching your proficiency), a set of common clothes, and a pouch containing 10 gp.
